ui_bugs.issue: offline-banner NEVER shows when navigator is offline. Root cause: the app-shell branch of sw.js (network-first with fallback to caches.match(req) || caches.match('/')) also intercepts /api/wishlist and /api/itineraries. When offline, the SW serves the previously cached JSON response with status 200, so axios succeeds → Wishlist.load() takes the 'ok' branch and never sets offlineAt, so OfflineBanner returns null. DestinationDetail.jsx has the same problem (banner also missing). Data IS shown offline (good), but the timestamp banner requirement is unmet.

action_items: Fix offline-banner detection. Options: (1) In Wishlist.jsx/DestinationDetail.jsx, in the 'ok' branch, additionally check `navigator.onLine === false` (or import isOffline() from /app/frontend/src/lib/offline.js which already exists but is unused) and if so, still set offlineAt from the cache's savedAt. (2) OR: exclude /api/* from sw.js interception entirely so offline API calls truly fail and trigger the existing cache-fallback branch that already sets offlineAt.
(LOW carry-over) Directory.jsx budget-select still renders <span> inside <option> (React hydration console warning) — unchanged from iter 5.
critical_code_review_comments: public/sw.js: fetch handler falls back to caches.match('/') for same-origin misses. This is the correct behavior for HTML navigations, but for /api/* JSON requests it either returns stale JSON (status 200) OR returns index.html HTML — both mask real offline state from the app. Recommend early-return `if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return;` (or restrict app-shell branch to `req.mode === 'navigate'` / destination === 'document').
Wishlist.jsx line 108–115: cache-fallback branch is only taken if BOTH /api/wishlist and /api/itineraries reject; because SW returns 200 for cached responses, this branch is unreachable in practice.
server.py PATCH /itineraries/{id}/share correctly returns 400/404/403/200 and generates uuid.uuid4().hex[:12] slug ONLY on first enable (subsequent enables keep slug — verified).
PublicItineraryOut does NOT leak user_id/id — good.
Planner.jsx correctly forwards `previous_content: previous.slice(0, 20000)` matching backend Field(max_length=20000).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend iteration 6 endpoints are all solid. The one open bug is offline banner not appearing due to sw.js intercepting /api/* successfully with cached response. Data-visibility offline is fine (both wishlist and destination detail render with cached data), but the banner-with-timestamp UX requirement is not satisfied. Fix in Wishlist.jsx/DestinationDetail.jsx by additionally consulting navigator.onLine, or exclude /api/* in sw.js.
rca of the issue: public/sw.js registers a fetch handler that for same-origin non-image requests does network-first with cache fallback to caches.match(req) || caches.match('/'). Because axios calls to /api/wishlist and /api/itineraries were previously cached during online visits, the offline reload receives a 200 JSON response served from the SW cache. Wishlist.load() then follows the success branch (setDests/setTrips from response, offlineAt=null, cacheSet('wishlist',...)). OfflineBanner returns null when !savedAt so it never appears. Reproduction: (1) login → visit /wishlist online (populates SW cache and localStorage); (2) DevTools set offline OR `page.context.set_offline(True)`; (3) navigate /wishlist → data appears but no [data-testid=offline-banner]. Verified live: `await page.evaluate(fetch('/api/wishlist'))` offline returns {status:200, ct:'application/json'}. Fix: gate offlineAt on `navigator.onLine === false` in the ok-branch too, or short-circuit sw.js for /api/*.
